title: Privacy policy
body: This policy defines how FinKeep processes and protects personal data submitted by website users. By using the website and submitting forms, the user confirms that they have read this policy.
We may process your name, phone number, email address, company name, and information voluntarily included in your message.
Data is used to respond to requests, prepare proposals, provide services, and improve the website. We do not disclose data to third parties except where required by law.
You may request information about processing, correct your data, or withdraw consent by emailing privacy@finkeep.ru.
